title: Karumi vs Naoma: which AI demo agent fits your team?
summary: Karumi vs Naoma in 2026: how each AI demo agent runs the demo, voice, live calls, languages, CRM, pricing and setup. Sources checked November 2026.
body_markdown:
Karumi and Naoma are both AI demo agents: each one talks with a buyer, shows the product and qualifies the lead without a rep. Pick Naoma if you want a website demo with a video avatar, published prices and billing per engaged demo; pick Karumi if you want an autonomous agent that shows your real product on every demo and also works in live sales calls and outbound.


Karumi is an AI demo agent: an autonomous agent that shows a buyer your real product live, by voice or chat, and answers questions as it goes. Naoma calls itself an "AI video sales agent" that runs personalized product demos 24/7 on your website ([naoma.ai](https://naoma.ai/) , checked November 2026). Every Naoma fact below has a source.


## Karumi vs Naoma at a glance


Compared Karumi Naoma


How the demo runs An autonomous agent decides what to show for each buyer and adapts as the buyer asks A flow of up to 10, 15 or 30 steps by plan; branching and buyer-adaptive paths from the Scale plan (\[pricing\](https://naoma.ai/pricing))


Real product or capture The real product on every plan. Not a recording, a replica or a tour Starter uses slides and screenshots; Growth and above drive the real product in a sandbox or demo account you provide (\[FAQ\](https://naoma.ai/faq))


Voice and chat Voice and chat Voice with a video avatar (animated, branded or photorealistic), plus a chat box (\[naoma.ai\](https://naoma.ai))


Live sales calls Joins Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls Runs on your website, in your app or from an email link; we found no mention of joining Meet, Zoom or Teams calls


Languages The buyer's language, set by the demo link or detected 80+ languages, detected from the browser (\[FAQ\](https://naoma.ai/faq)); multilingual demos from the Growth plan (\[pricing\](https://naoma.ai/pricing))


CRM HubSpot, Salesforce and Attio HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, Google Sheets, Zapier and webhooks (\[naoma.ai\](https://naoma.ai))


Pricing Growth and Enterprise plans, scoped on a call (\[pricing\](/pricing)) From $299 a month, or $249 billed annually, for 50 engaged demos (\[pricing\](https://naoma.ai/pricing))


Setup Scoped with the Karumi team; most teams start with a pilot Starter is self-serve; Growth and above get help from the Naoma team; Scale adds a demo engineer (\[FAQ\](https://naoma.ai/faq))


Security SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR on Enterprise GDPR; SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 not yet held, certifications "in progress" (\[FAQ\](https://naoma.ai/faq))


G2 4.9 from 11 reviews (\[G2\](https://www.g2.com/products/karumi/reviews)) 4.9 from 20 reviews (\[G2\](https://www.g2.com/products/naoma-ai/reviews))


All Naoma facts checked November 2026. Prices are as of November 2026.


## What is Naoma?


Naoma is an AI demo agent for B2B SaaS teams with inbound demand. A visitor clicks a button on your site, and a video avatar greets them, runs discovery, walks through the product and answers questions. At the end, Naoma routes the lead to your CRM, a booked meeting or self-serve checkout ([FAQ](https://naoma.ai/faq) , checked November 2026).


Naoma learns your product from sales scripts, demo recordings, the knowledge base, sales decks and a demo environment ([naoma.ai](https://naoma.ai/) ).


What Naoma does well:


- **Avatars.** You can pick the Naoma character, a branded mascot or a photorealistic avatar. Scale adds an avatar built only for your business.
- **Published, usage-based pricing.** A demo counts only when the prospect stays 3 minutes or more. When you hit your limit, demos pause, so there are no surprise charges ([pricing](https://naoma.ai/pricing) ).
- **Languages.** Naoma says it speaks 80+ languages and can switch mid-conversation. (Its G2 profile text still says 33, so ask which ones apply to your plan.)
- **Reviews.** Naoma has 4.9 stars from 20 reviews on[G2](https://www.g2.com/products/naoma-ai/reviews) . Reviewers praise the setup support; some say early versions skipped steps until the team tuned the flow.


## What is Karumi?


Karumi gives each buyer an autonomous agent on your real product. The agent understands the product, decides what to show and adapts to each buyer's questions. It is not a recording, a replica or a tour. You can read more in[is a Karumi demo live or a recording?](https://karumi.ai/blog/is-karumi-demo-live-or-recording) .


What Karumi does well:


- **One agent, every surface.** The same agent runs from a demo link, a website widget, a chat bar or an inline start screen.
- **Live calls.** Karumi joins Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls, so a rep can bring the agent into a real sales call. See[can Karumi join Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls?](https://karumi.ai/blog/can-karumi-join-google-meet-zoom-teams-calls) .
- **Outbound.** A live demo link goes into a cold email or sequence, pre-filled for the contact.
- **Qualification and CRM writes.** The agent qualifies and scores leads, books the meeting on the right rep's calendar and syncs sessions to HubSpot, Salesforce and Attio. See[what Karumi sends to HubSpot](https://karumi.ai/blog/what-does-karumi-send-to-hubspot) .


## How does each agent run the demo?


This is the biggest difference.


**Naoma runs flows.** Naoma defines a step as "one thing the agent shows, a slide, an image, or a single interface page." Starter allows up to 10 steps, Growth 15 and Scale 30. Branching and paths that adapt to the buyer's role and intent start on Scale ([pricing](https://naoma.ai/pricing) ). Naoma says it uses "structured flows and recovery logic" when the agent clicks wrong ([FAQ](https://naoma.ai/faq) ). That gives tight control over the story.


**Karumi runs an autonomous agent.** There is no step cap. The buyer asks for what they care about, and the agent decides what to open in the real product and explains it. In our experience, buyers often jump straight to the workflow they came for, or ask about pricing early, and the agent follows them.


## Does the buyer see the real product or a capture?


On Naoma, it depends on the plan. The $249 Starter plan builds the demo "from your slides & screenshots." From Growth ($750 a month billed annually, or $900 monthly), "the AI drives your actual product, not static images," logged into a dedicated sandbox or demo account you provide ([pricing](https://naoma.ai/pricing) ,[FAQ](https://naoma.ai/faq) , checked November 2026).


On Karumi, every demo runs on the real product. There is no slide or screenshot tier. For the category, read[what is an AI demo agent?](https://karumi.ai/blog/what-is-an-ai-demo-agent) .


## Voice, chat and live calls: where can each agent show up?


Both agents talk by voice and both accept typed questions.


Naoma's strength is presence: a face on screen. Its demo runs inside a widget, modal or page on your site, in your app or from an outbound email ([naoma.ai](https://naoma.ai/) ). Naoma lists Zoom as an integration, but we found no page that says the agent joins a Meet, Zoom or Teams call as a participant.


Karumi covers more places. Besides the website, the agent joins Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls, and it goes into outbound as a live, pre-filled demo link. The same agent serves a visitor at night and a rep's call the next morning.


## Languages, CRM and analytics


**Languages.** Naoma claims 80+ languages, detected from the browser, from the Growth plan up. Karumi runs the demo in the buyer's language, set by the demo link (for example \`utm_language\` or \`lang\`). See[which languages Karumi supports](https://karumi.ai/blog/which-languages-does-karumi-support) .


**CRM.** Naoma sends transcripts and lead data to your CRM, Google Sheets or Slack, and lists 9,000+ apps via Zapier ([naoma.ai](https://naoma.ai/) ). Karumi syncs sessions to HubSpot, Salesforce and Attio, with transcripts, summaries, qualification data and custom fields ([pricing](https://karumi.ai/pricing) ).


**Analytics.** Naoma surfaces competitors, objections and feature requests from demos. Karumi records every session with analytics and conversion events, readable by API.


## How much do Karumi and Naoma cost?


Naoma publishes four plans (as of November 2026, from[naoma.ai/pricing](https://naoma.ai/pricing) and its[FAQ](https://naoma.ai/faq) ):


Naoma plan Price billed annually Engaged demos a month Demo type


Starter $249/mo ($299 monthly) 50 Slides and screenshots, up to 10 steps


Growth $750/mo 100 Live product, up to 15 steps


Scale $2,083/mo 300 Live product with branching, up to 30 steps, 2 agents


Enterprise Custom Custom Unlimited agents, SSO, SLA


Karumi has two plans, Growth and Enterprise, as of November 2026. Pricing depends on the number of agents, demo volume, languages and integrations, and the team scopes it with you on a short call. Most teams start with a pilot on one use case ([karumi.ai/pricing](https://karumi.ai/pricing) ). Enterprise adds on-premise deployment, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR and SLAs.


Note: Naoma's own[Naoma vs Karumi post](https://naoma.ai/blog/naoma-vs-karumi) (last updated August 2026) quotes an older Karumi self-serve plan at $900 a month with one language. That plan is no longer on the Karumi pricing page.


## Who is each tool best for?


**Choose Naoma if:**


- You sell mainly through inbound website traffic and want every visitor to get an instant demo.
- You want a video avatar on screen, from a mascot to a photorealistic presenter.
- You want published prices and to pay only for demos that last 3 minutes or more.
- A fixed demo path fits your product, and slides are fine to start.


**Choose Karumi if:**


- You want the real product on every demo, with no slide tier.
- Your buyers ask different questions and you want an autonomous agent that follows them.
- You want the same agent in live Meet, Zoom or Teams calls and in outbound emails, not only on your website.
- You need SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 for your security review today.
- You want sessions, qualification and lead scores written to HubSpot, Salesforce or Attio.


For more options, see our comparisons of[Karumi vs 1mind](https://karumi.ai/blog/karumi-vs-1mind) and[Karumi vs Consensus](https://karumi.ai/blog/karumi-vs-consensus) .


## FAQ


### Is Naoma a live demo or a recording?


From the Growth plan, Naoma drives your real product live in a sandbox or demo account you provide. Its Starter plan builds the demo from slides and screenshots instead. Karumi runs on the real product on every plan.


### Does Naoma or Karumi have a voice agent?


Both do. Naoma talks by voice with a video avatar and also has a chat box. Karumi talks by voice or chat while it shows the product, and it can join Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls.


### Which is cheaper, Karumi or Naoma?


Naoma publishes its prices: from $299 a month, or $249 billed annually, for 50 engaged demos on slides, and $750 a month billed annually for live product demos (as of November 2026). Karumi scopes pricing by agents, demo volume, languages and integrations on a call, and most teams start with a pilot.


### Which supports more languages?


Naoma says it supports 80+ languages, detected from the browser, on Growth and above. Karumi runs each demo in the buyer's language, set by the demo link or detected. Test your languages with both.


### Is Naoma SOC 2 Type II certified?


Not yet. As of November 2026, Naoma's FAQ says it is GDPR-compliant and that SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications are in progress. Karumi's Enterprise plan includes SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR.


### Which has better reviews on G2?


Both have 4.9 out of 5 on G2 as of November 2026: Naoma from 20 reviews and Karumi from 11.


## See Karumi run a live demo


Start a live demo of Karumi, ask it anything, and watch it open the real product:[karumi.ai/demos](https://karumi.ai/demos) .
